changes: App me ab mouse se bhi copy-paste chalega — kisi bhi field me right-click karne par edit menu ayega (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Delete, Select All). Pehle Electron me default right-click menu hota hi nahi tha, is liye sirf Ctrl+V kaam karta tha.
notes: Naya version v1.6.13 tayyar hai (aap ke paas v1.6.12 hai). Right-click paste fix.
